clauses.quote: Teachers who accept assignments and then choose not to work will be considered as if they did work.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who accept assignments and then choose not to work
clauses.notes: Assigns a consequence/credit calculation that benefits management's payroll and accountability.

clauses.quote: Teachers who only teach one class or one intersession (except by choice) will be counted as one-half year worked.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who only teach one class or one intersession (except by choice)
clauses.notes: Defines service credit calculation for partial assignments.

clauses.quote: If a teacher applies for both regular summer school and driver training in summer school, he/she must choose one or the other.
clauses.notes: Requires exclusive selection between assignment types.

clauses.quote: In the event of a shortage of driver training teachers for summer school, he/she may elect to do both.
clauses.notes: Grants discretion to hold dual assignments under shortage conditions.

clauses.quote: A listing of all tentative intersession position openings shall be posted at each site offering intersessions.
clauses.subject_text: A listing of all tentative intersession position openings
clauses.notes: Management duty to publish vacancy listings.

clauses.quote: If positions are not filled by this process, the District shall distribute a list of vacancies to all sites where teachers would be available to teach intersession.
clauses.notes: Contingent management duty to circulate vacancies.

clauses.quote: Teachers interested shall apply directly to the site offering intersession.
Unit members shall be credited with .8 sick day for working 75% or more at four and one-half (4½) hours a day.
clauses.notes: Specifies sick leave accrual proration based on hours worked.

clauses.quote: Unit members who work more or less than four and one-half (4½) hours a day shall have sick leave prorated accordingly.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members who work more or less than four and one-half (4½) hours a day
clauses.notes: Specifies sick leave proration rule for non-standard work hours.
